title: Lock It Up: Android 17’s Latest QPR2 Beta Introduces a Built-In App Lock - CNET
summary: Currently, the app lock feature is available only on Pixel devices running QPR2 beta 3. The new built-in app lock feature would put Android on even footing with iOS, which introduced its app lock feature in iOS 18 back in 2024 .
